claims.claim_vi: The source lists six principles of fault-tolerant design: replication, redundancy, load balancing, failover mechanisms, graceful degradation, monitoring and alerting.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: For independent components, availability in series is the product of the availabilities and in parallel is 1 - (1-a)^n; two 99% components in parallel give 99.99%, three 99.9% components in series about 99.7%; 99%, 99.9%, 99.99% allow about 87.6 h, 8.76 h, 52.6 min of downtime a year.
claims.verified_by: Arithmetic checked by the author on 2026-10-19; the page itself was not opened in this session.

claims.claim_vi: The parallel formula holds only when failures are independent; shared causes (same software version, same site, same database) reduce the real gain.
claims.verified_by: Kiến thức chung của người biên soạn, chưa đối chiếu lại với trang này trong phiên viết (không mở được trang từ môi trường).

design_notes_vi: Hai khung thẻ nối nhau cho sáu nguyên tắc (ba và ba) và một khung ghi chú cho phép tính.
source_deviations: The source gives one definition per principle; the lesson groups them into replacement copies and reactions to failure.
The lesson adds the series and parallel availability calculation and its independence limit, which the source does not contain.
